title: GRADE 10 - UNIT 2 - TASK 4 - COLLOCATIONS & PHRASES SET 1

cards.extra1: set up + a club / project / system
cards.example: Students set up a green club at school.
The campaign aims to reduce plastic waste at school.
Teachers encourage students to use reusable bottles.
Volunteers cleaned up the school yard after the event.

cards.backContent: nâng cao nhận thức về điều gì
cards.example: The project raises awareness of climate change.
Many students are keen on joining environmental activities.
By working together, we are able to reduce waste.

cards.backContent: thu hút sự chú ý của ai
cards.example: The poster attracted students' attention to the recycling campaign.

cards.extra1: remember to + verb = nhớ làm việc cần làm
cards.example: Remember to turn off the lights before leaving the room.
Please turn off electrical devices when they are not in use.
Do not turn on the air conditioner unless it is necessary.

cards.extra1: turn up + the volume / heat; turn up = arrive/appear
cards.example: Please do not turn up the air conditioner too high.

cards.extra1: turn down + the volume / heat; turn down + an offer
cards.example: Turn down the air conditioner to save energy.

cards.extra1: pick up + litter / rubbish; pick somebody up
cards.example: Students picked up litter around the school.
The teacher reminded us to bring reusable water bottles.
